module: Synchronous variant of route.lua for races and rally: path on the navgraph with per-point metadata (metadata), merge and recalculation callbacks, and storage of the original fixed points so the full route can be recalculated. The path shortens as tracking proceeds, with an "on the path" threshold of 15 m. The module returns a constructor: `require(...)(removeFirst, useMapPathfinding, closeDistSquared, logTag)`.
usage:
local RaceRoute = require('/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/route/raceRoute')
local r = RaceRoute(true, true, 1)
r:setupPathMultiWithMetadata({{pos = p1}, {pos = p2, metadata = {name = 'cp'}}})
local idx, d = r:trackPosition(vehPos)
notes: Callbacks available in self.callbacks: onPointProcessed(point) after construction, shouldPointBeFixedForRecalc(point) for recalculateRouteWithOriginalPositions, onRouteShortened (declared but not called here), onMetadataMerge(i, last, cur) -> newPoint, newMetadata when merging close points.

Differences with route.lua: everything is synchronous (no core_jobsystem), onPathDist = 15 m, setupPathMultiWithMetadata sets each arrival as a fixed point and may not use map pathfinding (useMapPathfinding = false).
The logTag argument of init is local and has no effect (it shadows the module variable).
calcDistance crashes if the path is empty (self.path[1] is nil), unlike route.lua which handles this case.
recalculateRoute and recalculateRouteWithOriginalPositions emit the hook onRecalculatedRoute with the argument 'raceRoute'.
originalFixedPositions is filled only once, on the first setupPathMultiWithMetadata, and is not cleared by clear().
updatePathForPos resets the metadata of the first point to nil if it is repositioned (resetMetadata).

C.desc: Race route. Fields: path, removeFirst, useMapPathfinding, closeDistSquared, originalFixedPositions, dirMult, callbacks, trackingMutationEnabled, done, plus the search parameters (cutOffDrivability, penaltyAboveCutoff, penaltyBelowCutoff, wD, wZ).

removeFirst.desc: true (default): the first point is not fixed. false: it is marked fixed.

useMapPathfinding.desc: true (default): uses the navgraph; false: simply connects the positions.

closeDistSquared.desc: Squared distance (m2) below which two points are merged; default 1.

setTrackingMutationEnabled.desc: If false, updatePathForPos no longer modifies the path (no recalculation or shortening) and only returns the offset.

stepAhead.desc: Point located stepDist meters further along the route (same logic as route.lua).

reset.desc: true to restart from the beginning.

returns.desc: {n1, n2, idx, pos, xnorm}, nil if fewer than 2 points.

setupPathMultiWaypoints.desc: Appends to the path the navgraph nodes between given waypoints (map.getPath).

setupPathMulti.desc: Builds the path for a list of plain positions (wraps them in {pos=...} then calls setupPathMultiWithMetadata).

setupPathMultiWithMetadata.desc: Builds the path for positions with optional metadata. Each arrival becomes a fixed point that keeps its metadata; points that are too close are merged (onMetadataMerge callback possible); the endpoints are adjusted; onPointProcessed is called for each point; the original fixed points are stored on the first call.

positions.desc: List of {pos = vec3, wp = string|nil, metadata = any}. Only pos is required.

getNextFixedWP.desc: Position of the first fixed point of the path.

recalculateRoute.desc: Rebuilds the path from startPos, passing through all remaining fixed points, then emits onRecalculatedRoute('raceRoute').

recalculateRouteWithOriginalPositions.desc: Like recalculateRoute but starts from the original (unshortened) fixed points. An original point is kept if the shouldPointBeFixedForRecalc callback returns true, and the last point is always kept. Emits onRecalculatedRoute('raceRoute').

getPositionOffset.desc: Finds the closest segment to a position (threshold 15 m).

returns.desc: Segment index, 0 if off the path.
Minimum distance to the path in meters.

shortenPath.desc: Removes the points before index idx.

updatePathForPos.desc: Updates the route for a position: recalculates if off the path (>= 15 m), shortens the path and adjusts the first point (resetting its metadata to nil). Without allowed mutation, only computes the offset.
